scope: Split GYRE kt=1 stage-3 vector-form dyn_adv into dyn_keg and dyn_zad, score each through legoESM's own implementation given NEMO's operands, then stop at the operator-run acquisition boundary.

rule0_sources.dispatch: GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM_R40STG3TRM/BLD/ppsrc/nemo/dynadv.f90:134-138 selects np_VEC_c2 and calls dyn_keg(nn_dynkeg,Kmm) before dyn_zad(Kmm); round40_oracle_stage3_terms/ocean.output:798-799 resolves ln_dynadv_vec=T and nn_dynkeg=0.
rule0_sources.keg: GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM_R40STG3TRM/BLD/ppsrc/nemo/dynkeg.f90:117-130 forms zu as the two U squares, zv as the two V squares, zhke=0.25*(zv+zu), then subtracts the face difference times the stored r1_e1u/r1_e2v.
rule0_sources.zad: GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM_R40STG3TRM/BLD/ppsrc/nemo/dynzad.f90:105-137 reads ww at jk+1 and Kmm velocities, forms the two area-weighted W sums, and divides by the live Kmm e3u/e3v thickness; its bottom row consumes only the carried upper-interface term.
rule0_sources.ww_time_level: GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM_R40STG3TRM/BLD/ppsrc/nemo/stprk3_stg.f90:326-332 diagnoses ww immediately before the stage operators with wzv(Kbb,Kmm,Kaa,uu(Kmm),vv(Kmm),np_velocity). sshwzv.f90:271-298 sets the bottom to zero, builds div_hor from those Kmm velocities, and in key_qco integrates bottom-up with the Kaa-Kbb stretch.
rule0_sources.wsd_dead_arm: round40_oracle_stage3_terms/ocean.output:518 resolves ln_wave=F. The compiled sbcwave.f90:408-423 consequently forces ln_vortex_force=F and returns before wsd is allocated at :469-477. Therefore the executed dynzad.f90:111-114 arm reads ww alone; reading the unallocated wsd merely to dump it is forbidden. The record carries ln_vortex_force=0 and a writer-defined all-zero wsd_effective field, explicitly not the unallocated module object.

prediction.claim: KEG carries the first non-bit-exact statement and the round-40 dyn_adv debt: at least one KEG face row is DEBT relative to KEG's own magnitude, while both ZAD face rows are AT-BAR relative to ZAD's own magnitude. The predicted first statement is the C2 zhke association, before either face gradient.
prediction.basis: NEMO rounds the two same-component square sums independently and adds zv+zu; legoESM's current expression exposes a different four-add association. ZAD's active branch has already been transcribed statement-for-statement and its wsd alternative is dead on this deck.
prediction.falsifier: REFUTED if every KEG row is AT-BAR, or if any ZAD row is DEBT relative to its own magnitude. If both are DEBT, the exclusive 'KEG carries it' prediction is REFUTED and both first unequal statements must be named independently; no residual is assigned by subtraction or visual magnitude.

instrument.placement: WRITE-only additions around the live dyn_keg and dyn_zad calls, armed explicitly by stprk3_stg at kt=nit000,kstg=3; STATUS=REPLACE; rank/name/extents precede every payload.
instrument.closure: after_zad must equal round40 oracle_rkstage3_terms after_adv bit-for-bit on every stored value; every pre-existing consumed field must pass the round-40 admission against both the direct parent and the canonical tracer source run.
instrument.calibration: A literal independent replay updates before_keg with NEMO's source order and must equal after_keg at 0 unequal cells, then updates after_keg with NEMO's source order and must equal after_zad at 0 unequal cells. Any unequal calibration cell invalidates every scientific score.
instrument.model_score: The gate then executes legoESM's own KEG and ZAD implementation paths given the same NEMO operands. Each operator is scored on its post-statement accumulator and on its derived isolated contribution, with exactness and the 1e-15 relative bar both explicit.
instrument.plants: Separate KEG, ZAD, header, closure, calibration and commit-stamp plants must move their own named row and exit nonzero.

rule12_after_record.OVERFLOW: Resolve its namelist first. Same execute/not-applicable test and kt=1..10 requirement; ln_zad_Aimp is known live, so no assumption that GYRE's explicit ZAD arm executes is allowed.
